summary: Centralize JetBrains floating license pool and provision contractor seats
description:
Issue summary:
We need to consolidate multiple team-level JetBrains subscriptions into a centrally managed pool of floating 'All Products Pack' licenses and create a short-term contractor seat pool. This will reduce duplicate spend, simplify renewals, and provide fast on/off boarding for contractors and short-term hires.

Impact:
- Current state: several teams (Platform, SDK, Research) have independently purchased named JetBrains licenses; contractors are being added ad-hoc to team plans. This results in duplicate purchases, lack of centralized billing, and slow contractor onboarding (2-5 days).
- Business impact: delayed contractor ramp, excess spend (~$6k/yr estimated), and inconsistent access to IDE toolchains across teams.

Background and request:
- Request procurement of 120 JetBrains All Products Pack floating seats managed by a central JetBrains License Server (self-hosted) or equivalent enterprise offering.
- Create a time-limited contractor pool of 20 seats reserved for the next 6 months. Contractors should be able to be assigned seats by IT within 2 hours of request.
- Integrate provisioning with SCIM/Okta where possible to allow automated deprovisioning when contractor accounts are disabled.
- Route billing to cost center INFRA-OPS and include budget code RD-INFRA-2026.
- Legal needs to review JetBrains EULA for enterprise use (link needed to review).
- Preferred provisioning deadline: 2026-04-15 to support upcoming contractor intake for the SDK team.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Central license server deployed and reachable from corporate network (VPC or allowed egress) with documented admin runbook.
2) 120 floating seats available and assigned to central pool.
3) 20 contractor seats reserved and a documented quick-request flow for IT to allocate/deallocate within 2 hours.
4) SCIM/Okta integration plan drafted; at minimum, a manual offboarding checklist exists.
5) Billing and cost center mapping confirmed with Finance and procurement.

Estimated cost and billing:
- Quote estimate: ~$24,000/year for 120 All Products Pack floating seats (final quote required).
- Contractor pool: prorated for 6 months; include line item for seat transfer if required.

Stakeholders:
- Requesting: SDK Team (Liaison: Priya Nair)
- Procurement: Marcus Liu
- IT/Platform: Marcus Liu, Infra Ops
- Finance: Olivia Chen
- Legal: Daniel Romero

Required next steps:
1) Procurement to request formal quote from JetBrains sales for floating enterprise licensing and available deployment options (license server vs cloud licensing).
2) IT to validate whether self-hosted JetBrains License Server is acceptable under security policies or if JetBrains Cloud licensing is required.
3) Legal to review licensing terms.
4) Finance to confirm budget and set up cost center routing.
5) Prepare onboarding playbook for contractors and notify hiring managers of new SLAs.

Notes on urgency: Medium — P2. Deadline driven by contractor intake on 2026-04-20 but planning should complete earlier to avoid onboarding delays.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Filing this to centralize spend and speed contractor onboarding for SDK + Platform. Attached initial count of current named licenses per team (Platform: 32, SDK: 18, Research: 14, Other: 9).
2026-03-11 - Marcus Liu: I'll reach out to JetBrains account rep for a formal quote and ask about floating license server options. Marking action: request quote by 2026-03-14.

2026-03-11 - Olivia Chen (Finance): Need to confirm whether INFRA-OPS has available headroom; please include a budget code in the quote request. We'll expedite approval once we have a formal invoice/quote.

2026-03-12 - Daniel Romero (Legal): I'll queue a contract/EULA review. Please provide link to JetBrains standard agreement or sales quote when available. Estimated turnaround 3 business days after receipt.

2026-03-12 - Marcus Liu: Preliminary vendor notes: JetBrains offers both on-premise license server (legacy) and per-seat cloud-based licensing. Cloud per-seat may simplify SCIM integration but could complicate floating behavior. Need sales to confirm how contractor pools are supported.
investigation_notes: Audit finding 2026-03-09: Found 5 separate JetBrains purchase records across Concur this fiscal year; at least two are duplicate All Products Pack purchases where teams bought overlapping coverage.
Security check: Self-hosted license server requires outbound connectivity to JetBrains for activation; Security flagged potential egress requirement—IT to map egress policy.
SCIM feasibility: Okta connector exists for JetBrains cloud; for on-prem license server, automated provisioning is limited. Workaround: IT-managed seat assignment script using LDAP groups.
Migration risk: Named->floating migration may require re-provisioning of licenses to users and a short interruption; schedule maintenance window for reassignments.
acceptance_criteria: Central license pool deployed and documented
120 seats provisioned and visible in admin console
Contractor pool of 20 seats with documented request flow
SCIM/Okta integration plan or manual offboarding checklist in place
Billing routed to INFRA-OPS and Finance sign-off completed
